notToBeConfusedWith.name: Tennessee whiskey
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Made to the same rules and then filtered through sugar-maple charcoal before barrelling, which is the step its makers treat as the distinction.

generalSubstitutes.note: Drier and sharper in the same place bourbon is round and sweet; a sour made with it reads leaner and needs no other adjustment.

forms.label: Standard strength
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, distilled, whiskey, 86 proof. Public domain. 86 US proof is 43% alcohol by volume by definition; the record's measured ethanol against its measured density gives 42.9%. Bourbon is bottled at 40% and upwards, and 86 proof is the commonest strength above the legal floor. Gluten is not flagged: the spirit is distilled from grain and carries no protein through the still.
